purpose: Describes EXISTING mappings only. Contains NO proposed experimental values.
semanticContractStatus: ABSENT - no field has a declared semantic contract in either repository

fields.kronosInferredMeaning: relative multiplier on inpatient admission demand
fields.sourceVariable: count of EXTREME_WEATHER events in the current tick pending list
fields.drTransform: baseAdmit = floor(rng()*3) in {0,1,2}; scaledAdmit = floor(baseAdmit * m); toAdmit = min(availableBeds, max(1, scaledAdmit))

measuredResponse.onsetTick: first change at m = 1.50 (fine scan 1.40-1.48 showed no change)

fields.temporalSemantics: assigned on any tick with an event; latched thereafter (no reset to 1.0)
fields.silentDiscard: max(1, .) discards every decrease below m = 1.0

fields.adapterTransform: max(scp, 0.4) on EXTREME_WEATHER; min(1, scp + 0.1) on WAR_CASUALTIES
fields.drTransform: effectiveMin = minStock + (maxStock - minStock) * p; restock to maxStock if stock < effectiveMin; evaluated ONLY when clock.tick % 50 === 0
fields.quantization: thresholded; measurable response confined to approximately 0.475-0.525
fields.temporalSemantics: assigned on any tick with a qualifying event; latched; evaluated only at restock boundaries
fields.timeQuantization: clock.tick % 50 === 0; trajectories identical for p=0.0/0.4/0.5/1.0 through KE tick 14, divergence only at KE tick 15
fields.atAdapterValue: DISCARDED (0.4 lies in the dead zone)

fields.drTransform: mapMacroDisasterToScenario(type) -> SCENARIO_DEFS lookup; scenario severity HARDCODED 0.6
unreachableMappings: mass-casualty is defined in the DR mapping but never emitted by this adapter
fields.saturation: one active scenario at a time; activation suppressed while a scenario is active
fields.temporalSemantics: activates a scenario on that tick; the scenario then runs its own phase cycle over its duration

fields.measuredResponse: 0.85 has NO effect on occupancy, ICU occupancy, supplyStress or encounters
fields.note: WAR_START never fires because era RP-CONTEMP-002 has zero wars

evidence.consumed: never - adapter schedules only the four macro events at :299-311; zero references on the DR side

fields.note: DR has its own ICD-weight mechanism via SCENARIO_DEFS.icdWeights (getScenarioEffects), not wired to any adapter input

absentOrDiscardedPathways.validRange: UNSPECIFIED (intended approximately 1-7.5; observed approximately 30 under the coupling defect)
absentOrDiscardedPathways.incompatibility: unbounded magnitude vs normalized [0,1]; a direct mapping would repeat the unit-error class identified three times elsewhere in this system

absentOrDiscardedPathways.classification: STRUCTURALLY ABSENT in practice at this horizon and severity

modelingDecisionsRequired: admissionMultiplier: declare intended semantics and valid range; state whether a 3-state target is acceptable
supplyChainPressure: declare intended semantics and valid range; state whether restock-boundary time quantization is acceptable
severity: resolve MAPPING STATUS UNDEFINED (transmit nothing by design, or define a normalization with explicit rationale)
diagnosisWeightOverrides: resolve lifecycle status (deprecated / reserved / planned / accidental)
staffAvailabilityModifier: declare whether it is intended to affect sentinel endpoints, and which
primary endpoint: select, given supplyStress is threshold- and horizon-limited
